home: What is ImgUpscaler?

ImgUpscaler is an online AI image upscaler for photos, illustrations, products, and portraits. Choose 2K or 4K output to create a higher-resolution image; available output sizes depend on the model and account limits.
How does an AI image upscaler work?
The selected AI model analyzes edges, textures, and color relationships before generating higher-resolution detail instead of simply stretching pixels.
How do I upscale an image online?
Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF image, choose an output size, then preview and download the processed image.
Can I upscale an image to 4K?
Yes. You can choose a 4K output. The API applies the selected model and account limits to the requested resolution.
What is the difference between upscaling and enhancement?
Upscaling focuses on increasing canvas size and resolution. Enhancement focuses on clarity, noise, texture, and color. Both can use the same upload and download workflow.
Can AI enhancement fix a blurry image?
It can improve mild blur, compression noise, and jagged edges, but it cannot guarantee recovery of information that was never captured or is fully obscured.
Which image formats are supported?
Supported formats are JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF, up to 20 MB per image.
Can I upscale multiple images at once?
Yes. The workspace accepts up to 20 images and processes them in queue order, with each result available to download when ready.
Are my uploaded images private?
Images are uploaded through short-lived signed URLs, processed by the selected model, and returned as private results under the API retention policy.
How long are uploaded images stored?
Source files and results follow the API retention policy and are removed according to the service cleanup schedule.
Can I use the upscaled images commercially?
The frontend does not restrict export use. Commercial licensing, model output responsibility, and source-image rights should be defined in the production terms.
Which images work best with AI upscaling?
Low-resolution photos, product images, portraits, anime art, scans, and lightly compressed old photos often show the clearest improvement.
Is AI upscaling better than regular resizing?
Regular resizing interpolates existing pixels. AI upscaling attempts to reconstruct detail; the result depends on source quality, the model, and the target size.
Do I need to install software?
No. Use the tool directly in your browser; image processing takes place on our servers.
enhancer: What is an AI image enhancer?
An AI image enhancer automatically improves image quality by sharpening blur, restoring detail, reducing noise, and removing compression artifacts without manual editing.
How do I enhance image quality online?
Upload an image, choose an enhancement output, preview the result, and download it. The workflow runs in the browser.
Can AI make a blurry image clearer?
AI can improve mild blur, noise, and compression damage, but it cannot guarantee recovery of detail that was never captured.
Can I improve image detail without editing manually?
Yes. The enhancer processes edges, textures, noise, and compression artifacts automatically.
What is the difference between enhancement and upscaling?
Enhancement focuses on clarity, texture, and noise. Upscaling focuses on canvas size and resolution.
Will the enhancer reduce blur and noise automatically?
The selected AI model performs denoising and restoration before returning the result.
Does it support compressed JPEG or web images?
Yes. JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF are supported.
Can I enhance AI-generated images?
Yes. AI art, portraits, product visuals, and illustrations work well with this workflow.
Can I enhance portraits naturally?
Use a moderate strength and compare the result before downloading to avoid over-sharpening.
Can I improve product photos?
Yes. The enhancer works for ecommerce listings, marketing assets, and website images.
Will enhancement change the original colors?
The selected AI model controls enhancement strength and color fidelity for the returned result.
Which images work best with the enhancer?
Portraits, screenshots, old photos, product images, anime, and low-resolution web images are good candidates.
Can I preview an enhanced image before downloading?
Yes. The result appears in the workspace first and can be edited or downloaded.
Do I need editing skills to use the enhancer?
No. Upload an image, choose an output, and download the result.
reimagine: What is Reimagine AI?
Reimagine AI is ImgUpscaler’s prompt-guided creative upscaler. It enlarges an image while generating new detail, texture, and visual variation from your prompt and settings.
How is Reimagine AI different from a regular upscaler?
A regular upscaler focuses on preserving the source while increasing resolution. Reimagine AI can also add generative detail from a prompt.
What is a creative image upscaler?
It combines resolution enhancement with generative AI to infer new detail, texture, patterns, and stylistic improvements from the source.
How do prompts affect a reimagined result?
Prompts describe lighting, materials, style, detail level, atmosphere, or how the subject should be treated.
What does the Creativity control do?
Higher creativity introduces more variation, texture, and new visual detail. Lower creativity keeps the result closer to the source.
What is Resemblance strength?
Higher resemblance helps preserve the original layout, subject features, and recognizable structure.
Which settings give stable results?
Use lower creativity and higher resemblance for portraits and images where the original composition matters.
Can I reimagine a portrait without changing the face too much?
Yes. Use the portrait model with lower creativity and higher resemblance.
Which image types work best with Reimagine AI?
Portraits, architecture, interiors, anime art, illustrations, product photos, and old photos are good candidates.
Is Reimagine AI an alternative to Magnific?
It can be used as a lightweight prompt-guided creative upscaler.
Can I use Reimagine AI outputs commercially?
Yes, subject to applicable law and the rights associated with the original images.
Are uploaded images private?
The API uses short-lived signed URLs and its configured cleanup policy for uploaded images and results.
